content:
jessica (AE): Kicking off POC with OpaqueBank — they want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC role mapping, and strict domain proofing. Trial window is 30 days. Can we align on scope + blockers? :wave:

olivia (SE): I'll take the SE lead. Quick q — Okta + Azure AD only or are they planning multiple IDPs?
jessica (AE): Both. Okta primary, Azure AD secondary. They want delta SCIM sync, bulk import, and group->role mapping.
mike (solutions): For RBAC they need nested group support and tenant-scoped admins. Current SCIM supports groups + custom attribute mapping; for nested groups recommend mapping from IDP to explicit role attributes. Example SCIM PATCH we can demo:
```
PATCH /Users/2819
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"groups","value":[{"display":"finance","value":"gid-123"}]}]
}
```

tara (security): Security asks: SAML metadata export, cert rotation every 90 days, audit trail for admin role changes, and SOC2 report. Also they want answers to pen test cadence. I'll prep our standard pack.
devon (infra): Private deployment options: VPC + customer KMS available. Note: Dedicated has a minimum commit for capacity (we usually do 3-month minimum for Reserved). For a short POC we can offer hosted with strict network controls and IP allowlist. Pricing team needs to confirm numbers.
jessica (AE): Domain proofing — they want to prevent domain squatting and require tenant ownership validation. We support DKIM/CNAME verification + admin-verified SSO enforcement during signup.
olivia (SE): For delegated admin UX we have two templates: org_admin (creates tenants, billing) and tenant_admin (user/role mgmt). We can show mapping doc and demo the admin flows.
tara (security): Q from their SecQ: "Can you enforce invites only from verified domains?" Answer: yes — domain allowlist + mandatory SSO can be enforced. I'll paste canonical Q/A into the questionnaire.
security-bot: Attached: sec-questionnaire-opaquebank-2026.pdf
mike (solutions): SCIM rate-limits: we default to 60 req/min for hosted, dedicated can be bumped depending on commit. For delta-heavy provisioning recommend batching and our SCIM bulk endpoint for initial sync.
jessica (AE): Contract/legal asks: they want a short NDA + POC addendum that covers IP, data handling, and rollback plan for dedicated infra. Looping in legal: @marco.
marco (legal): Will send NDA + POC addendum. Need product + infra confirmation for any dedicated infra commitments and the minimums before I finalize.
devon (infra): Confirmed — we require signoff for dedicated nodes; there are also options for ephemeral Dedicated POCs if finance approves.
olivia (SE): Proposed next steps: SE demo Thu 10am PT (live SAML/SCIM + RBAC walkthrough), security Qs answered by Tara by EOD Wed, infra/pricing confirmed by Devon + Mike by Wed EOD.
jessica (AE): I'll update the commercial proposal after pricing and NDA. Action items: Olivia demo, Tara sec pack, Marco NDA, Devon pricing. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mike (solutions): One more item — they asked whether we support provisioning with custom role attributes (e.g., entitlement=read,write). Answer: yes — attribute mappings supported. We'll include a sample mapping file in the demo.
jessica (AE): Perfect. I'll schedule the demo invite and include OpaqueBank SRE + IAM contacts.
security-bot: Reminder: please redact any customer credentials from attachments before sharing.
